name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: A paragraph in faint type that lights up word by word to full colour, like text being read aloud or scrolled into focus.
useWhen: A statement or manifesto should be read word by word at a steady pace.
A paragraph needs a progressive highlight from faint to solid.
avoidWhen: Words should move or scale in: use per-word-rise or text-animate.
A single short headline: use a letter or word entrance instead.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text
variables.default: This text lights up one word at a time as you read, until every word is clear.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. The paragraph wraps inside 86 % of the frame width.

variables.label: Faint level
variables.description: How visible unread words are, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Start
variables.description: Seconds before the first word starts to light up.

variables.label: Reveal time
variables.description: Seconds from the first word starting to the last word finished. The source ties this to scrolling.
